title: SSO and SAML support
text:
Status: In progress. Target: Q1.

We are adding SAML 2.0 single sign-on so enterprise customers can authenticate through Okta, Azure AD, and OneLogin. SCIM user provisioning is a follow-up, tracked separately.

Open questions: whether to support IdP-initiated login in the first release, and how to migrate existing password accounts onto a linked SSO identity without locking anyone out.

This supersedes the older "custom OAuth per customer" proposal, which did not scale past a handful of tenants.
